clue.text: Migratory bird seen by the wharf

definitions.meaning: a crane that travels with the seasons, a bird on the move
a gantry lifting machine running on rails along a dockside

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher spots a seasonal visitor perched near the docks.
explanation.definitionFit: A migrating crane is a wandering bird, and the rail-mounted hoist that runs along quays has the same two-word name.

clue.text: Gratified by having caught a trout

definitions.meaning: trout can be landed by stroking them under the belly by hand, an old poacher's method

explanation.surface: An angler is delighted after landing a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Amused and pleased are synonyms here, and poachers catch fish by gently stroking them in the water.

clue.text: A king and queen on an island off Scotland

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sitting on another means it comes above it, so first

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for rex, Latin for king
R is the abbreviation for regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A royal couple holiday on a Scottish island.
explanation.walkthrough: ARRAN is an island in the Firth of Clyde.
explanation.definitionFit: Arran is a large island in the Firth of Clyde, west of the Scottish mainland.

clue.text: Alien male shattered by 8th-Army victory

indicators.note: something shattered is broken into pieces, so these letters are reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: An extraterrestrial man is overwhelmed by a famous wartime army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shattered' rearranges ALIENMALE. The British Eighth Army won the 1942 battle in Egypt under Montgomery.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eighth Army's decisive North African triumph of 1942 was fought at this Egyptian railway halt.

clue.text: Lure fish back from the sheltered side

indicators.note: back means the joined words for lure and fish are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to draw someone is to lure or attract them
an eel is a snake-like fish

explanation.surface: Tempting a fish to return from a protected spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns DRAWEEL around as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: The side away from the wind is the protected one, the nautical term for the sheltered quarter.

clue.text: Unsettled by cross depicted in crude icon

indicators.note: depicted in means one piece is shown inside another, so it goes within
crude means rough and unrefined, so the letters of icon are rearranged roughly

parts.note: cross means angry, which is mad

explanation.surface: Someone is disturbed by a cross painted into a primitive religious image.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like the crucifix shown in the icon, but here it means angry. 'crude' scrambles the icon's letters, and 'depicted in' places the angry word inside that scramble.
explanation.definitionFit: A wandering, rootless lifestyle with no fixed home is one that is not settled.

clue.text: Is allowed to produce a piece of poetry

parts.note: can means is permitted, as in you can go

explanation.surface: Permission is granted to write some verse.
explanation.definitionFit: A major section of a long poem, such as Dante's Inferno, is called by this Italian name.

clue.text: All together formerly

definitions.meaning: simultaneously, everything happening in the same moment
once upon a time, in the past

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both simultaneously and once in the past, two senses of a single moment.

clue.text: Yes, cats can provide great delight

indicators.note: can provide suggests the letters of yes and cats may be rearranged to make something new

explanation.surface: Yes, cats can be a source of real joy.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapture or bliss, an overwhelming feeling of joy, is the meaning here.

clue.text: Slaughter a horse in care

indicators.note: in means the horse word sits within the letters of care

parts.note: a nag is an old or worn-out horse

explanation.surface: A horse is slaughtered while under someone's care.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' is just the article before horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Massacre or bloodshed on a large scale is the meaning.

clue.text: Guy tries to get fruit

parts.note: a guy is a man
goes means tries, as in has a go

explanation.surface: A man makes an attempt to get some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Tropical stone fruits with orange flesh, plural to match the plural noun.

clue.text: Provide a labourer temporarily to help out

definitions.meaning: taken literally, loaning a worker, a hand being a manual labourer

explanation.surface: A firm loans out a worker to give assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to assist, and read literally it means loaning out a farmhand or labourer.

clue.text: In Europe radio broadcasts work of note

indicators.note: In means the letters sit inside the words Europe radio, spanning them

explanation.surface: Radio stations across the continent play a piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A dramatic stage work set to music, a musical composition, with note meaning a musical tone.

clue.text: Make insensitive daughter accept hopeless situation

parts.note: to deaden is to numb or make insensitive

explanation.surface: Dulling a daughter's feelings so she accepts a hopeless plight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accept' only links the pieces here; D simply follows DEADEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A street with no way through, figuratively a course of action leading nowhere.

clue.text: Greek seaman displaying dry humour

parts.note: Attic means of Attica, the region around Athens, so Greek
an old salt is an experienced sailor

explanation.surface: A Greek sailor shows a dry wit.
explanation.definitionFit: Refined, pointed wit, named after the elegant style of ancient Athenian speakers.

clue.text: Cautious about it being seen as philanthropy

indicators.note: about means the cautious word goes around it

parts.note: chary means wary or cautious

explanation.surface: Someone wary of their gift being seen as do-gooding.
explanation.definitionFit: Generosity toward those in need, giving to good causes, is the sense.

clue.text: Dread having to make an arrest

definitions.meaning: to fear something to come, an old sense

explanation.surface: A policeman fears having to detain a suspect.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to fear anxiously and to seize a suspect; the anxious sense survives in apprehension.

clue.text: Somehow obtain a large number of plants

indicators.note: somehow means in some unspecified way, so the letters of obtain are rearranged

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a large number

explanation.surface: Getting hold of plenty of greenery somehow.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the science of vegetation, as in a garden of plant specimens.

clue.text: Giving support is refreshing

definitions.meaning: propping up with struts or braces

explanation.surface: Being supportive feels invigorating.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplying braces gives support, and brisk invigorating air is described this way too.

clue.text: Chirpy little creatures

parts.note: chirpy suggests cheerful, but here it is literal: insects that chirp loudly

explanation.definitionFit: These insects make a loud shrill chirping sound by vibrating membranes on their bodies.

clue.text: Clearly stated by former newsmen

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
the press means journalists collectively

explanation.surface: Former journalists made their views plain.
explanation.definitionFit: An explicit wish is one stated plainly rather than implied.

clue.text: Model is no longer well-proportioned

parts.note: ex means no longer, former
ample means generously proportioned

explanation.surface: A fashion model has lost her curvy figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern to follow or copy, a standard for others.

clue.text: Has herself visited the liquor house?

parts.note: she is the female pronoun, standing for herself
been is used for visited, as in I have been to Paris

explanation.surface: Has she been to the drinking den?
explanation.walkthrough: A SHEBEEN is an illicit drinking place, originally Irish.
explanation.definitionFit: An unlicensed bar or drinking den, chiefly in Ireland, Scotland and South Africa.

clue.text: Course a drunkard imbibes champagne initially!

indicators.note: imbibes means drinks in, so one piece is taken inside another

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of champagne

explanation.surface: A drunk racegoer knocks back some fizz to start.
explanation.walkthrough: ASCOT is a racecourse in Berkshire, England, famous for Royal Ascot.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous English racecourse, home of a fashionable summer race meeting.

clue.text: Prickly old English character

parts.note: reads as a grumpy elderly Englishman, but means a spiky letter from the Old English alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: A runic letter used in Old English for the th sound shares its name with a spike on a rose stem.

clue.text: Unusually fierce sea battle ends with it

indicators.note: unusually means in an uncommon way, so the letters of fierce and sea are rearranged

explanation.surface: A ferocious naval battle comes to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: A truce, the order to stop shooting, is what brings fighting to a close.

clue.text: It metamorphosed one minute previously

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
ago means in the past, previously

explanation.surface: Something changed shape just a moment ago.
explanation.definitionFit: The final adult stage of an insect, reached after transformation from larva or pupa.

clue.text: Where etymologists may find interest briefly

definitions.meaning: students of word origins study each vocabulary item, literally the place their interest lies

explanation.surface: Word historians take a brief interest.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to put it concisely, and literally names the place word scholars look.

clue.text: Portent in the era of unwisdom?

definitions.meaning: playfully read as ..., the time before anyone was wise

explanation.surface: An omen from a foolish age.
explanation.definitionFit: An omen or foreboding sign; jokingly also a time before wise men.

clue.text: Go to bed, duck

definitions.meaning: to sleep, settle down for the night
to lower oneself to avoid being hit or seen

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both to sleep and to crouch low to avoid a blow or keep a low profile.
